principle: Extract only capabilities that advance IDEA_TO_REAL; reuse existing owners and add no tables.

affiliates.destination: customer export; unsettled obligations reconcile through the existing payout owner
affiliates.reason: Affiliate administration is not required for IDEA_TO_REAL and Builderforce must not gain a parallel referral economy.

phoneVoip.destination: existing Twilio connector for workflow calls; customer number port-out/export for SignalWire product state
phoneVoip.reason: A hosted phone carrier product is outside IDEA_TO_REAL; connector actions remain available without a second phone platform.

blogContent.destination: knowledge_documents and existing content-manager/public artifact routes
blogContent.reason: Published knowledge advances delivery and already has an owner; preserve content, canonical slugs and redirects without content_items DDL.

webPush.destination: existing email and in-app notification channels
webPush.reason: Do not reverse migration 0195 or reintroduce VAPID, a queue and a PWA package solely for legacy campaign delivery.

pricing.destination: planFeatures, featureGate, consumption meters, kernel ledger, carts, orders and order_line_items
pricing.reason: Builderforce pricing and consumption policy remains canonical; credits become a ledger/meter denomination or are refunded, never a parallel balance system.

providers.destination: existing connector catalog and provider seams
providers.reason: Secrets are not copied across products; retained integrations are reauthorized and non-target providers are disconnected after export/reconciliation.

stripe.dataAction: map customers, subscriptions, invoices, refunds and webhook idempotency keys

helcim.dataAction: settle or refund open obligations before shutdown

plaid.dataAction: export finance history; reconnect only for an active retained finance workflow

signalwire.dataAction: export call/SMS history and port or release every active number

recall.dataAction: export retained recordings/transcripts into existing artifacts; do not copy bot credentials

tavily.dataAction: use Builderforce web-search routing; no platform-key transfer

email.dataAction: preserve suppression/unsubscribe evidence before callback switch

slack.dataAction: reconnect through the existing connector catalog

google.dataAction: reconnect and select scopes through the existing connector catalog

microsoft.dataAction: reconnect and select scopes through the existing connector catalog

github.dataAction: reconnect through the existing source-control owner

linkedin.dataAction: export provenance; do not copy OAuth tokens
